name: 11357 · Whitestone, NY
findings: ZIP 11357 (Whitestone) has 127 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 40 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11357 (Whitestone) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
91% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 11357 (Whitestone) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 6.7 times the typical level).
